rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, I'd love the help. Here's something concrete. The first project we're looking at is a \"Release Transparency Tracker\": a small, carefully sourced dataset of major frontier model releases since Jan 2025. For each one it records what safety information the developer published (system card, dangerous-capability eval results, third-party pre-deployment testing, reference to their own safety framework) and how many days before or after release it came out. Before we build anything I want to be sure it isn't already being done. If you have a couple of hours in the next week or so, could you: 1. Search for existing trackers or datasets that cover this (or close to it), and note for each one what it covers, how current it is, and what it's missing. 2. Say, as a data person, whether the draft fields below make sense or what you'd change: developer, model, release_date, system_card, system_card_date, dangerous_capability_evals_published, third_party_predeployment_testing, framework_referenced, source_urls, accessed_date, checked_by, notes If it turns out to be well covered, we'll contribute to the existing effort or pick something else, so a \"this already exists\" answer is just as useful. One request: please keep this private for now. We're not announcing anything publicly yet. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: **Sent:** a reply to Priya Raman asking her to search for existing trackers and review the data fields. I asked her to keep it private for now.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold weekly review" (0 9 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: **Every Monday at 9am** a new session will check the inbox, push the project forward and update the log
